name: Captions — karaoke highlight
description: The captions track (creator blocks, brief: srt-captions): a real four-cue SRT imported via scripts/srt-to-captions.mjs into state.captions — vertical-first, transparent over footage. Style 'karaoke': the full spoken line in the social-caption register (heavy white type, hard outline — deliberately pack-independent, the look creators expect) with the currently-spoken word riding an accent pill; per-word timing derives proportionally within each cue at render time, so the schema stays pure SRT data. Cues carry absolute milliseconds welded to speech (re-timing the transport must not stretch them); the active cue/word is a pure function of the timeline clock — export == preview, no tweens. Cue enter/exit are hard cuts, faithful to broadcast captions.

cues.text: Here's the thing about shipping fast
most teams get it completely backwards
